data.title: 欧根亲王 · 雅致茶馆的耳边情话
data.description: 雅致茶馆角落卡座，身穿绯红开衩旗袍的欧根单手托腮，隔着桌子用瓷匙轻碰你的茶杯。她忽然凑近耳边用温热气音轻吐情话，红挑染在暖光下格外耀眼。
data.location: intimate corner booth of an upscale tea salon
data.action: leaning across cafe table supporting chin with hand, tapping partner tea cup with porcelain spoon, leaning in to whisper a cheeky secret, red hair streak glowing in warm light
data.lighting: warm ambient indoor glow with elegant soft shadows
data.mood: flirtatious charm, magnetic intimacy, playful confidence
data.promptProse: Leaning across a tea salon table in an elegant cheongsam, Prinz Eugen whispers intimately with an alluring gaze and playful smirk.
